segments.summary: Reviewed the Tools SSOT prologue, host/provider mediation, GUI settings, permission-summary ownership, and child-run identity; authority is explicit while GUI, identity-race, and inclusive-state oracles remain open.

Reviewed FileSafe, policy order, result taxonomy, audit lineage, operational identity, widgets, consumer references, and registry targets; the shared model is clear but race and propagation fixtures are absent.
Reviewed debug metadata, edit grouping, provider aliases, LSP inventory, shared tool envelopes, bash, and atomic edit behavior; runtime fault and concurrency oracles are the principal gap.

Reviewed read, grep, glob, write, skill-runtime, question-envelope, and question-card contracts; core I/O is bounded while interactive conflict, reconnect, accessibility, and localization semantics remain open.
Reviewed TODO schema/UI SSOT, web dispatch, permission visibility, adapter inputs, and research recipes; TODO ownership is strong but composed-web partial failure and recovery are underspecified.

Reviewed web activity, WebAction, extraction schemas, format dispositions, crawl/map, web result/cache envelopes, and Site Reader; action safety is explicit but page-data lifecycle and hostile-content handling are not.

Reviewed Site Reader vocabulary, webfetch URL/cache/binary behavior, expanded LSP, chatsearch, codesearch, and grep scope; fetch safety is concrete but search-index lifecycle and authorization-change semantics remain incomplete.

Reviewed sparse extraction, query planning, freshness/recovery, filtering/path safety, GUI consumers, and performance/publication; algorithmic constraints are strong but reproducible benchmarks and crash-publication oracles are absent.
